Aisha (CS): Quick heads-up — Tenant Gamma goes live tomorrow 09:00 PT. They chose the lightweight onboarding path; goal is stable performance and capturing early renewal signals.

Marco (CS): Awesome. What’s the recommended warmup/prefill recipe for low-touch?

Aisha (CS): Keep it small and targeted. Steps I’m proposing: 1) prefill the shared prefix cache for top 3 user flows, 2) run a 15-min low-rate warmup ramp (0.5–2 rps), 3) enable streaming for the demo path only, 4) enable short KV cache TTLs for the first 72h so we can iterate.

Aisha (CS): Prefill example we gave to customers:
```
POST /v1/prefill
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "tenant_id": "gamma",
  "flows": ["signup_flow","search_hint","summary_flow"],
  "rate_per_flow": 1,
  "stagger_seconds": 10
}
```

Rory (SRE): Operational notes: stagger by 10s between tenants to avoid burst queues, cap concurrent warmup jobs to 3, and set autoscale headroom to +30% for the first 6 hours. If any node hits >85% GPU util, pause warmup and notify oncall. (oncall-bot will auto-post).

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: warmup-check at 09:30 PT tomorrow.

Jules (PM): For renewal-risk tracking — capture these signals during the first 72h: sustained errors >5% by route, median response latency >800ms on primary flows, and >20% dropped streaming sessions. If any trigger fires, label "early_risk" and escalate to AMs.

Marco (CS): For customer-facing guidance, I recommend a 1‑pager we can send that includes: minimal prefill JSON, expected cost delta (estimate), how to pause warmup, and a short checklist for customers to run quick smoke tests.

Aisha (CS): Agreed. Quick checklist draft:
- Run prefill for top 3 flows (sample above)
- Run smoke test: 5 sample queries via streaming + 5 via non-streaming
- Confirm latency <1s for median and error rate <2%
- Share feedback form link with product team

Marco (CS): Capture feedback via short in-app survey (3 Qs) + a 1:1 in week 1 for high-touch customers. For low-touch, we skip 1:1 unless early_risk is flagged.

Rory (SRE): Also log these tags to tracing: tenant_id, prefill_run_id, warmup_stage. Makes it easy to query in dashboards.

Aisha (CS): Post-launch follow-up cadence: Day 0 — warmup + smoke; Day 1 — health sync (CS + SRE); Day 3 — retention signal check; Day 7 — customer feedback capture + baseline report.

Jules (PM): Can someone draft the 1-pager and the short survey? I can add the renewal signal thresholds into the AM handbook.

Marco (CS): I’ll draft the 1-pager and send for quick review by EOD.

Aisha (CS): Thanks — tagging @rory for any ops caveats. :thumbsup:

Rory (SRE): LGTM. I’ll add the dashboard panels and hook up oncall alerts.
